note: Darki's guard. 0 = neutral stance (the same height as his idle/jab guard, which is why it is the bodyFrame), 1 = arms coming up, 2-3 = the full cover, forearms over the head. Played as RAISE 0->3 on the press, HOLD on 3 for as long as the button is down, DROP 2->1->0 on release — so it is a held state, not a one-shot: the source manifest's 'play once forward' is the preview setting. Frames 2-3 measure taller than 0 (524 vs 493 source px) because the arms go up over his head; bodyFrame 0 is what stops that inflating his on-screen size. 2:1 downsample of ASSETS/NEW SPRITES/Darki_Block.png (see _chromakey/newmoves_prep.js).
